note: Adapted from the redescription in Bacchus (1987); original English. The monograph keeps fatulus as the valid name and lists Light's 1933 occidentalis (preoccupied) as the original name. The original description (Light 1935, Proc. Calif. Acad. Sci. 4th ser. 21(20): 233–258) could not be obtained locally, so the revision is cited; per Bacchus the holotype alate comes from María Madre Island, Mexico, and was not examined; the specimens examined had broken antennae and no wings. Localities, material examined and figures are not translated.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: This species was originally named Kalotermes (Cryptotermes) occidentalis by Light (1933); as that name was preoccupied, Light (1935) proposed the new name fatulus. The alate is close to C. verruculosus and differs in having an arolium between the tarsal claws (C. darwini and C. kirbyi lack one). The soldier closely resembles C. longicollis, but in this species the frontal horn is a very short knob and the genal horn is scarcely developed, whereas in C. longicollis the frontal horn is longer and larger than the genal horn.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text:
Head capsule yellowish-brown, distinctly or only slightly paler above the ocelli; frons with a brown edge above the antennal sockets, paler behind the middle of the clypeus, with or without a V-shaped mark; clypeus pale yellow; labrum yellow; pronotum distinctly paler than the head and abdominal tergites, the tergites paler than or concolorous with the back of the head; antennae yellow, concolorous; legs and sternites pale yellow to yellow.
Posterior margin of the head evenly rounded; cranial suture absent or present; eyes and ocelli oval, the ocelli touching or very close to the eyes; anterior margin of the clypeus convex; antennae incomplete in the specimens examined (broken), segment 3 shorter than 2. Pronotum narrower than the maximum head width; anterior margin moderately and widely concave, sides almost parallel or rounded, posterior margin slightly emarginate or almost straight; mesonotum and metanotum with distinct median sutures; wings absent in the specimens examined. Arolium present.
Measurements (five specimens from three nest series; mean in parentheses): head length to lateral base of mandibles 0.78–0.91 mm (0.84), maximum width of head with eyes 0.85–0.91 mm (0.89), maximum length of labrum 0.18–0.20 mm (0.19), maximum width of labrum 0.37–0.49 mm (0.42), maximum diameter of compound eye 0.26–0.34 mm (0.30), minimum diameter of compound eye 0.22–0.26 mm (0.24), maximum diameter of lateral ocellus 0.07–0.10 mm (0.09), minimum diameter of lateral ocellus 0.05–0.09 mm (0.08), minimum ocellus/antennal distance 0.15–0.20 mm (0.17), minimum eye/antennal distance 0.03–0.06 mm (0.04), minimum distance of eye from lateral base of head 0.11–0.16 mm (0.13), maximum length of pronotum 0.59–0.70 mm (0.62), median length of pronotum 0.52–0.60 mm (0.56), maximum width of pronotum 0.78–0.90 mm (0.84), length of hind tibia 0.73–0.78 mm (0.76), length of fore wing scale 0.77–0.86 mm (0.79).

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Head capsule black in the front half and reddish-brown posteriorly; antennae, labrum, body and legs yellow; mandibles dark reddish-brown.
The head is squarish, narrowing slightly posteriorly, weakly to moderately rugose in the black region. Frontal ridge fairly prominent, broader and thicker in the middle region, with or without a narrow median groove; anterior margin weakly concave, weakly recurved above the antennal sockets; in profile the head is flattened just behind the frontal ridge medially. Frons concave and tuberculate; labrum tongue-shaped, anteclypeus a narrow strip. Antennae with 11–12 segments, segments 1 and 2 large, 3 short, 3 and 4 smallest and subequal. Mandibles very short and broad, strongly angled from the basal third, dentition well developed. Genal and frontal horns small, the frontal longer. Pronotum deeply concave in front, margin roughened, anterolateral corners somewhat acute, sides rounded, posterior margin faintly emarginate.
Measurements (19 specimens from 10 nest series; mean in parentheses): head length to lateral base of mandibles 0.60–0.81 mm (0.71), height of head excluding postmentum 0.65–0.86 mm (0.78), length of head to cephalic ridge 1 0.99–1.13 mm (1.04), length of head to cephalic ridge 2 0.88–1.07 mm (0.96), maximum width of head 0.96–1.04 mm (1.00), maximum length of labrum 0.10–0.14 mm (0.12), maximum width of labrum 0.16–0.22 mm (0.20), maximum length of pronotum 0.57–0.68 mm (0.64), median length of pronotum 0.49–0.60 mm (0.55), maximum width of pronotum 0.83–0.99 mm (0.92), maximum width of mesonotum 0.78–0.91 mm (0.84), maximum width of metanotum 0.83–0.99 mm (0.87), length of hind tibia 0.57–0.65 mm (0.61), length of left mandible 0.42–0.52 mm (0.50), left mandible, apical to first marginal 0.12–0.14 mm (0.13), left mandible, first to third marginal 0.10–0.13 mm (0.12), right mandible, apical to first marginal 0.13–0.16 mm (0.15), right mandible, first to second marginal 0.08–0.09 mm (0.08).
